+void ff_blend_add_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,

+                        uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                        ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                        FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_and_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                        const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                        uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                        ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                        FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_or_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                       const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                       uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                       ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                       FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_xor_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                        const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                        uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,

+                        FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_darken_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                           const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                           uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                           ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                           FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_lighten_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                            const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                            uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                            ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                            FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_diff_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                         const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                         uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                         ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                         FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_extremity_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                              const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,

+                              ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,

+void ff_blend_grainextract_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,

+void ff_blend_hardmix_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                            const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,

+                            ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                            FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_multiply_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                             const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                             uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                             ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                             FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_screen_8_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                           const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                           uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                           ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                           FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+
+void ff_blend_add_16_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                         const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                         uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                         ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                         FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_sub_16_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                         const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                         uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                         ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                         FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_and_16_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                         const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                         uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                         ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                         FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_grainextract_16_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                                  const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                                  uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                                  ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                                  FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_grainmerge_16_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                                const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                                uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                                ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                                FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_lighten_16_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                             const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                             uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                             ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                             FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+void ff_blend_phoenix_16_rvv(const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+                             const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+                             uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+                             ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+                             FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam);
+
+#define init_blend8(name, m)                                     \
+    if (param->mode == m && param->opacity == 1.f)               \
+        param->blend = ff_blend_##name##_8_rvv
+
+#define init_blend16(name, m)                                    \
+    if (param->mode == m && param->opacity == 1.f)               \
+        param->blend = ff_blend_##name##_16_rvv
+
+av_cold void ff_blend_init_riscv(FilterParams *param, int depth)
+{
+#if HAVE_RVV
+    int flags = av_get_cpu_flags();
+
+    if (flags & AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV_I32) {
+        if (depth == 8) {
+            init_blend8(add, BLEND_ADDITION);
+            init_blend8(sub, BLEND_SUBTRACT);
+            init_blend8(and, BLEND_AND);
+            init_blend8(or, BLEND_OR);
+            init_blend8(xor, BLEND_XOR);
+            init_blend8(darken, BLEND_DARKEN);
+            init_blend8(lighten, BLEND_LIGHTEN);
+            init_blend8(diff, BLEND_DIFFERENCE);
+            init_blend8(extremity, BLEND_EXTREMITY);
+            init_blend8(grainextract, BLEND_GRAINEXTRACT);
+            init_blend8(grainmerge, BLEND_GRAINMERGE);
+            init_blend8(hardmix, BLEND_HARDMIX);
+            init_blend8(multiply, BLEND_MULTIPLY);
+            init_blend8(screen, BLEND_SCREEN);
+        } else if (depth == 16) {
+            init_blend16(add, BLEND_ADDITION);
+            init_blend16(sub, BLEND_SUBTRACT);
+            init_blend16(and, BLEND_AND);
+            init_blend16(grainextract, BLEND_GRAINEXTRACT);
+            init_blend16(grainmerge, BLEND_GRAINMERGE);
+            init_blend16(lighten, BLEND_LIGHTEN);
+            init_blend16(phoenix, BLEND_PHOENIX);
+        }
+    }
+#endif
+}
diff --git a/libavfilter/riscv/vf_blend_rvv.S b/libavfilter/riscv/vf_blend_rvv.S
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..d74dc482ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/libavfilter/riscv/vf_blend_rvv.S
@@ -0,0 +1,403 @@
+/*
+ * This file is part of FFmpeg.
+ *
+ * FFmpeg is free software; you can redistribute it and/or
+ * modify it under the terms of the GNU Lesser General Public
+ * License as published by the Free Software Foundation; either
+ * version 2.1 of the License, or (at your option) any later version.
+ *
+ * FFmpeg is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
+ * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
+ * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.  See the GNU
+ * Lesser General Public License for more details.
+ *
+ * You should have received a copy of the GNU Lesser General Public
+ * License along with FFmpeg; if not, write to the Free Software
+ * Foundation, Inc., 51 Franklin Street, Fifth Floor, Boston, MA 02110-1301 USA
+ */
+
+#include "libavutil/riscv/asm.S"
+
+// Blend kernels for the opacity == 1 case (dst = blend_mode(top, bottom)),
+// matching the C reference in libavfilter/blend_modes.c.
+// Signature (same as the C blend_* functions):
+//   void (const uint8_t *top, ptrdiff_t top_linesize,
+//         const uint8_t *bottom, ptrdiff_t bottom_linesize,
+//         uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t dst_linesize,
+//         ptrdiff_t width, ptrdiff_t height,
+//         FilterParams *param, SliceParams *sliceparam)
+// a0=top a1=top_linesize a2=bottom a3=bottom_linesize
+// a4=dst a5=dst_linesize a6=width a7=height
+// t0 = remaining, t1 = vl, t2 = MAX, t3 = HALF, t4 = scratch
+
+// 8-bit kernels (MAX = 255, HALF = 128)
+.macro blend8_prologue
+        lpad    0
+        li      t2, 255
+        li      t3, 128
+.endm
+
+.macro blend8_epilogue
+        vse8.v          v24, (a4)
+        sub             t0, t0, t1
+        add             a0, a0, t1
+        add             a2, a2, t1
+        add             a4, a4, t1
+        bnez            t0, 2b
+        sub             a0, a0, a6
+        sub             a2, a2, a6
+        sub             a4, a4, a6
+        add             a0, a0, a1
+        add             a2, a2, a3
+        add             a4, a4, a5
+        addi            a7, a7, -1
+        bnez            a7, 1b
+        ret
+.endm
+
+// add: min(255, a+b)  (e16 to avoid wrap)
+func ff_blend_add_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vwaddu.vv       v24, v8, v16
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vminu.vx        v24, v24, t2
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// sub: max(0, a-b)  (e16 signed; unsigned widen first)
+func ff_blend_sub_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vmv.v.i         v25, 1
+        vwmulu.vv       v26, v8, v25
+        vwmulu.vv       v27, v16, v25
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vsub.vv         v24, v26, v27
+        vmax.vx         v24, v24, zero
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// and
+func ff_blend_and_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vand.vv         v24, v8, v16
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// or
+func ff_blend_or_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vor.vv          v24, v8, v16
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// xor
+func ff_blend_xor_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vxor.vv         v24, v8, v16
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// darken: min(a,b)
+func ff_blend_darken_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vminu.vv        v24, v8, v16
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// lighten: max(a,b)
+func ff_blend_lighten_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vmaxu.vv        v24, v8, v16
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// difference: |a-b|  (e16 signed; unsigned widen first)
+func ff_blend_diff_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vmv.v.i         v25, 1
+        vwmulu.vv       v26, v8, v25
+        vwmulu.vv       v27, v16, v25
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vsub.vv         v24, v26, v27
+        vneg.v          v25, v24
+        vmax.vv         v24, v24, v25
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// extremity: |255 - a - b|  (e16 signed; unsigned widen first)
+func ff_blend_extremity_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vmv.v.i         v25, 1
+        vwmulu.vv       v26, v8, v25
+        vwmulu.vv       v27, v16, v25
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vadd.vv         v24, v26, v27
+        vrsub.vx        v24, v24, t2
+        vneg.v          v25, v24
+        vmax.vv         v24, v24, v25
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// grainextract: clip(128 + a - b, 0, 255)  (e16 signed; unsigned widen first)
+func ff_blend_grainextract_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vmv.v.i         v25, 1
+        vwmulu.vv       v26, v8, v25
+        vwmulu.vv       v27, v16, v25
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vsub.vv         v24, v26, v27
+        vadd.vx         v24, v24, t3
+        vmax.vx         v24, v24, zero
+        vminu.vx        v24, v24, t2
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// grainmerge: clip(a + b - 128, 0, 255)  (e16)
+func ff_blend_grainmerge_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vwaddu.vv       v24, v8, v16
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vsub.vx         v24, v24, t3
+        vmax.vx         v24, v24, zero
+        vminu.vx        v24, v24, t2
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// hardmix: (a + b < 255) ? 0 : 255
+func ff_blend_hardmix_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vwaddu.vv       v26, v8, v16
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vmsltu.vx       v0, v26, t2
+        li              t4, 255
+        vmv.v.x         v25, t4
+        vmerge.vxm      v24, v25, zero, v0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// multiply: a * b / 255  (e16 product)
+func ff_blend_multiply_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vwmulu.vv       v24, v8, v16
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vdivu.vx        v24, v24, t2
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// screen: 255 - (255 - a) * (255 - b) / 255
+func ff_blend_screen_8_rvv, zve32x
+        blend8_prologue
+1:      mv      t0, a6
+2:      vsetvli         t1, t0, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v          v8, (a0)
+        vle8.v          v16, (a2)
+        vrsub.vx        v24, v8, t2
+        vrsub.vx        v25, v16, t2
+        vwmulu.vv       v26, v24, v25
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vdivu.vx        v26, v26, t2
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v26, 0
+        vsetvli         zero, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vrsub.vx        v24, v24, t2
+        blend8_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+// 16-bit kernels (MAX = 65535, HALF = 32768); samples are uint16_t.
+.macro blend16_prologue
+        lpad    0
+        li      t2, 65535
+        li      t3, 32768
+.endm
+
+.macro blend16_epilogue
+        vse16.v         v24, (a4)
+        sub             t0, t0, t1
+        slli            t1, t1, 1
+        add             a0, a0, t1
+        add             a2, a2, t1
+        add             a4, a4, t1
+        bnez            t0, 2b
